groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Strong Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.711% and the 10Y at 4.984%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -6.27% over five sessions and -5.60% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.49% at about $91.53, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is strong negative (-48/100, 81% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is falling oil on the supportive side versus semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in Nasdaq breadth is weak, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
